title: Northgate Science Museum: annual visitors by ticket type, 2020-2024
bodyMd: The chart below shows the number of visitors to the Northgate Science Museum in each of five years, broken down by ticket type. All figures are in thousands of visitors. Every visitor is counted under exactly one ticket type, so the three figures for a year add to that year's total attendance.

data.caption: Visitors to the Northgate Science Museum, in thousands, by ticket type and year.

accessibilityText: A grouped bar chart showing visitors to the Northgate Science Museum, in thousands, for each year from 2020 to 2024, under three ticket types: general admission, student and member. In 2020: general admission 120, student 40, member 60, for a total of 220. In 2021: general admission 150, student 50, member 66, for a total of 266. In 2022: general admission 180, student 60, member 84, for a total of 324. In 2023: general admission 198, student 72, member 90, for a total of 360. In 2024: general admission 210, student 90, member 108, for a total of 408. Every visitor is counted under exactly one ticket type, so the three figures for a year add to that year's total attendance.

provenance.notes: Original data interpretation set written for the wave 3 top-up. The Northgate Science Museum is invented and every figure was constructed by the author so that the accompanying questions compute cleanly. Not drawn from any ETS material or from any real museum's attendance statistics.
